title: Vintage Cut Crystal Highball Glass, Swirl Twist Barware - Used
descriptionText:
Vintage cut crystal highball glass in very good condition. No chips or cracks observed. Light surface wear and minor manufacturing bubbles visible under close inspection. Clean and clear with a heavy weighted base.

Vintage clear cut crystal highball glass featuring an elegant swirl twist pattern with angular cut detailing. Thick heavy base with a solid feel. Classic mid century barware style suitable for water cocktails or display.
No visible maker mark. Pattern appears hand cut or high quality pressed crystal. A great replacement piece or addition to a vintage barware collection.
Please review all photos carefully as they are part of the description. You will receive the exact glass shown.
